result.title: AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection--Extended Version
result.comment: 25 pages. An extended version of "AMP-OD: Active Model Probing for Unsupervised Outlier Model Selection" accepted at KDD 2027
result.summary: Outlier detection is often deployed in fully unsupervised settings, where labels are unavailable and practitioners must choose a detector without direct performance feedback. Existing unsupervised outlier model selection methods predict detector quality from static meta-features and historical performance on meta-datasets, but they commit before observing how any detector behaves on the target dataset. We propose AMP-OD, an execution-conditioned probe-then-commit framework. AMP-OD runs a small number of inexpensive probe detectors, uses their score patterns as target-dataset evidence, and then selects a final detector from a larger candidate pool. To interpret unlabeled probe responses, we introduce a Leave-One-Out Family Probe Posterior (LOO-FPP), which converts probe score patterns into gated detector-family evidence while reducing self-validation in pseudo-label construction. AMP-OD further combines this evidence with historical reliability through a warm-start prior, a sequential probe/stop policy, and lower-confidence-bound arbitration. Extensive experiments and ablation studies show that detector responses provide useful evidence beyond static meta-features, with the LOO-FPP and conservative arbitration as key contributors.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AMP-OD：先在目标数据集上运行少量廉价 probe 检测器，把其得分模式作为证据，经 Leave-One-Out Family Probe Posterior 转为带门控的检测器族证据，再结合历史可靠性先验、序贯 probe/停止策略与 LCB 仲裁选出最终检测器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先探查后提交」、序贯停止与证据门控的思路，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡和 latent 证据筛选提供概念参照；但该工作属非视觉的无监督模型选择，实际迁移线索需较多核查。
